pages.text: [#](53341a)Hobgoblins are small, territorial, and largely reasonable as long as you do not disturb their patron. They live in woodland huts and trade in koboldite, a metal found only through their commerce.[#]()
pages.title: Hobgoblins

pages.name: Hobgoblin
pages.text: [#](53341a)Five trades, each unlocked by the last. Coal into dust; dust and gold into nuggets; work upward. The koboldite at the end is genuinely useful.[#]()

[#](53341a)Hobgoblins recognize village homes. Once one settles near enough beds, it keeps to the village and will work its way home if it wanders too far. A settled Hobgoblin also remains part of the village when distant players leave.[#]()
pages.title: Village Life

pages.text: [#](53341a)Three Hobgoblins within eight blocks form a raiding pack. Only then will they hunt villagers, and that same pack has the sense to flee a Village Guard. A lone Hobgoblin or a pair leaves villagers and guards alone unless attacked.[#]()

[#](53341a)Two adult Hobgoblins may court for a time and produce a baby when their village has room. Their population is limited to thirty-five percent of nearby homes: nine beds, for example, support at most three Hobgoblins.[#]()
pages.title: Hobgoblin Families

pages.text: [#](53341a)Babies grow through the ordinary day-and-night passage of time and keep their own profession markings. Leash work, worship, conversation, following, and guard orders take precedence over this village life.[#]()

[#](53341a)Craft the statue as a small figure: Stone-Koboldite-Stone across the top, Stone in the middle, and two Stone feet. Bind it to yourself in a small Ritual circle with Belladonna Flower, Poppy, Dandelion, and 4000 altar power.[#]()
pages.title: The Patron Statue

pages.text: [#](53341a)The finished statue keeps your name and likeness when broken, carried, or placed again.[#]() [#](53341a)Only the bound owner receives its gifts. Hobgoblins within eight blocks are drawn to worship, and the statue counts them every five seconds.[#]()
[#](53341a)Five worshippers restore 30 infusion energy each pulse. Ten grant Worship I for one minute; fifteen grant Worship II and permit a rare paired visit from Mog and Gulg.[#]()
pages.title: Worship and the Goblin Gods

pages.text: [#](53341a)For a deliberate summons, the owner offers a Nether Star while five Hobgoblins are actively worshipping. Mog and Gulg arrive together on safe ground, and only then are the star and five worshippers consumed.[#]()
[#](53341a)Existing gods, too few worshippers, unsafe ground, or the wrong player leave the offering untouched.[#]()
[#](53341a)The pair cannot be hurt while standing within three blocks of one another. Separate them to open their defenses. Gulg throws victims skyward; Mog punishes airborne prey.[#]()
pages.title: Mog and Gulg

pages.text: [#](53341a)Mog's Quiver supplies limitless fast arrows, triples damage against airborne targets, and inflicts Weakness. Gulg's Gurdle makes empty-handed blows deal five damage and launch.[#]()
[#](53341a)Quiver and Gurdle wearers within eight blocks grant each other Resistance II.[#]()
